title: DL-008 Root Cause Analysis — DL-029 Forward-Scan CC-Before-QID Artifact

defect_classification.mechanism: CorrectChoice appears BEFORE QuestionID in all 5 pack files. A scanner that (a) finds QuestionID then (b) searches FORWARD for CorrectChoice captures the NEXT QID's answer letter.
defect_classification.fp_rate: ~75% — with 4 equally distributed answer letters, only ~25% of adjacent QIDs share the same CorrectChoice
defect_classification.scope: All 5 packs affected. Forward-scan produces false positives on ALL packs, not just Pack B as DL-029 originally stated.

violation_taxonomy.historical_resolution: S700-S710 remediation cycles (March/April 2026) cleared all genuine DL-008 items. The 67-item count from SESSION_STATUS_2026-07-24 was run AFTER remediation was complete, producing false positives on already-clean items.

architectural_findings.architecture: ALL 5 packs use SINGLE-OBJECT architecture. Each QuestionID has exactly one JSON object containing both CorrectChoice and ExplanationWrong[A-D] fields.
architectural_findings.cc_vs_qid_position: CorrectChoice before QuestionID in ALL 5 packs (universal pattern). Average CC-to-QID distance: ~1,058 characters.
architectural_findings.dual_block: No dual-block (separate metadata + content JSON objects) exists in any current file. The DL-016 entry's description of a paired-object structure with flat ChoiceA-D fields describes a historical format that has since been normalized away.
architectural_findings.flat_choice_fields: 0 occurrences of flat 'ChoiceA'/'ChoiceB'/'ChoiceC'/'ChoiceD' fields across all 5 packs. All packs use nested 'Choices.{A,B,C,D}' format.

reliable_methods: Function constructor parse (100% reliable) — extracts CC and EW from the exact same object
Reverse-scan: find CC, then scan BACKWARD to QID (~95% reliable)
Within-object extraction: find object boundaries via string-aware brace matching, extract CC and EW from same body (~95% reliable)
avoid: Forward-scan from QuestionID to CorrectChoice → ~75% false positive rate on ALL packs
Flat regex without positional boundary awareness
Separate CC extraction and EW extraction passes that rely on positional indexing

impact.s800_blockers: All 3 P0 blockers (67 DL-008, FD-045, FD-075) were false alarms from this methodology defect
impact.governance_guard_rule2: Partially immune — uses ±1200 char window, direction-agnostic, but vulnerable on large objects where CC-EW distance exceeds window
impact.session_status_staleness: SESSION_STATUS_2026-07-24 §DL-008 section must be updated from 67→0
